transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I can’t get past this feeling that I’ve failed—as a father, and just as a useful person. It keeps going around in my head, and I start feeling like I don’t really deserve much of a future.
How long have you been feeling this way—has it been a matter of days to weeks, or has it been going on for months or longer?
About a month now. It really started after my daughter left for college out of state.
Over this past month, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with people?
Yeah. I used to look forward to working on my model railway, and watching Cubs games with my daughter. Now the trains are just sitting there half-built, and even turning on a game feels pointless.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep over this past month—trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah. I lie awake for hours sometimes—the house feels too quiet. Then I wake up around three or four in the morning and can’t get back to sleep. My mind just starts going over everything I’ve messed up.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or that you'd be better off dead during this past month?
I've had thoughts that it might be easier if I just didn't wake up. That scares me. I also caught myself going over my finances like I was getting things ready for someone else.
Over this past month, has your mood and these symptoms made it hard for you to keep up with your usual daily responsibilities, like work or taking care of things at home?

Yeah. Bills are piling up, and I’ve got house projects I just can’t make myself finish. I’ve also stopped going to book club or rides, so I’m not seeing the few people I used to rely on. And after I started organizing my finances like somebody else might need to take over... I don’t feel like I can just brush this off anymore.
Beyond these passive thoughts of not waking up, have you thought about a specific plan or method for ending your life?

I haven’t worked out a specific method. It’s more that I keep thinking it would be easier not to wake up. But going through my finances like someone else might need to handle things afterward—that scared me.
Have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things others don't, or having beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to believe, during this time?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that.

Have you ever had a period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or irritable, needed much less sleep than usual, or found yourself taking on a lot more projects or spending than normal?
I’m not sure. I haven’t noticed a period where I felt unusually up or energetic like that.
